de.dek: The Federal Reserve left its benchmark interest rate unchanged on October 28, 2026, as it awaited more data on inflation.
body: According to AP News, the Federal Reserve left its benchmark interest rate unchanged on October 28, 2026. Reuters also reported the rate was held steady.
According to MS NOW, the decision was made as the central bank awaited additional data on inflation. Reuters said the Fed awaited the accumulation of more information.
According to Reuters, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said politics played no role in the rate decision. Der Spiegel reported the same statement.
The New York Times noted the Fed is in an 'information-rich period' before its next meeting.
AP News reported that inflation remains elevated. The Fed has been monitoring inflation closely.
According to Warsh, he was honored to lead the Fed. He emphasized the decision was based on data, not politics.
facts: Fed left benchmark interest rate unchanged
Decision made while awaiting additional inflation data
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said politics played no role
Fed is in an information-rich period before next meeting
Fed awaited accumulation of more information

de.body: Laut AP News ließ die Fed ihren Leitzins unverändert. Laut MS NOW wurde die Entscheidung getroffen, während die Zentralbank auf zusätzliche Inflationsdaten wartete.
de.headline: Fed hält die Zinsen trotz hoher Inflation konstant

en.body: According to AP News, the Fed left its benchmark interest rate unchanged. According to MS NOW, the decision was made as the central bank awaited additional data on inflation.
en.headline: Fed holds rates steady despite elevated inflation

es.body: Según AP News, la Fed dejó sin cambios su tasa de interés de referencia. Según MS NOW, la decisión se tomó mientras el banco central esperaba datos adicionales sobre la inflación.
es.headline: La Fed mantiene las tasas sin cambios a pesar de la inflación elevada

fr.body: Selon AP News, la Fed a laissé son taux d'intérêt de référence inchangé. Selon MS NOW, la décision a été prise alors que la banque centrale attendait des données supplémentaires sur l'inflation.
fr.headline: La Fed maintient les taux stables malgré une inflation élevée

it.body: Secondo AP News, la Fed ha lasciato invariato il tasso di interesse di riferimento. Secondo MS NOW, la decisione è stata presa mentre la banca centrale attendeva ulteriori dati sull'inflazione.
it.headline: La Fed mantiene i tassi stabili nonostante l'inflazione elevata

ja.body: APニュースによると、連邦準備制度はベンチマーク金利を据え置いた。MS NOWによると、金利決定はインフレに関する追加データを待つ中で行われた。
ja.headline: 連邦準備制度は高いインフレにもかかわらず金利を据え置く

ko.body: AP 뉴스에 따르면 연준은 기준 금리를 변동 없이 유지했다. MS NOW에 따르면 중앙은행은 인플레이션에 대한 추가 데이터를 기다리면서 결정을 내렸다.
ko.headline: 연준, 고인플레이션에도 금리 동결

pt.body: De acordo com a AP News, o Fed deixou a sua taxa de referência de juros inalterada. Segundo a MS NOW, a decisão foi tomada enquanto o banco central aguardava dados adicionais sobre a inflação.
pt.headline: Fed mantém as taxas estáveis apesar da inflação elevada

zh.body: 据美联社报道，美联储将基准利率维持不变。据MS NOW报道，决定是在央行等待更多通胀数据时作出的。
zh.headline: 美联储维持利率不变，尽管通胀仍高

de.body: Laut Reuters sagte Fed-Vorsitzender Kevin Warsh, dass Politik keine Rolle bei der Zinssatzentscheidung gespielt habe. Laut Der Spiegel äußerte Warsh dasselbe.
de.headline: Warsh sagt, Politik spielte keine Rolle bei der Zinssatzentscheidung der Fed

en.body: According to Reuters, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said politics played no role in the rate decision. According to Der Spiegel, Warsh stated the same.
en.headline: Warsh says politics played no role in Fed's rate decision

es.body: Según Reuters, el presidente de la Fed, Kevin Warsh, dijo que la política no jugó ningún papel en la decisión de tasas. Según Der Spiegel, Warsh afirmó lo mismo.
es.headline: Warsh afirma que la política no influyó en la decisión de tasas de la Fed

fr.body: Selon Reuters, le président de la Fed, Kevin Warsh, a déclaré que la politique n'avait joué aucun rôle dans la décision de taux. Selon Der Spiegel, Warsh a déclaré la même chose.
fr.headline: Warsh affirme que la politique n'a joué aucun rôle dans la décision de taux de la Fed

it.body: Secondo Reuters, il presidente della Fed Kevin Warsh ha affermato che la politica non ha avuto ruolo nella decisione sui tassi. Secondo Der Spiegel, Warsh ha dichiarato lo stesso.
it.headline: Warsh afferma che la politica non ha avuto ruolo nella decisione sui tassi della Fed

ja.body: ロイターによると、連邦準備制度理事長ケビン・ウォルシュは政治が金利決定に影響しなかったと述べた。デア・スピゲルによると、ウォルシュは同じことを述べた。
ja.headline: ウォルシュ氏は政治が金利決定に影響しなかったと語る

ko.body: 로이터에 따르면 연준 의장 케빈 워시는 금리 결정에 정치가 개입되지 않았다고 말했다. 데어 스피겔에 따르면 워시는 같은 말을 했다.
ko.headline: 워시, 연준 금리 결정에 정치가 개입되지 않았다고 말함

pt.body: De acordo com a Reuters, o presidente do Fed Kevin Warsh afirmou que a política não teve papel na decisão sobre a taxa. O Der Spiegel reporta que Warsh declarou o mesmo.
pt.headline: Warsh afirma que a política não influenciou a decisão do Fed sobre as taxas

zh.body: 据路透社报道，美联储主席凯文·沃什表示政治未在加息决定中发挥作用。据《明镜周刊》报道，沃什同样表述。
zh.headline: 沃什称政治未影响美联储加息决定

de.body: Laut Reuters ließ die Fed ihren Leitzins unverändert, während sie die 'Anhäufung weiterer Informationen' abwartete. Laut The New York Times befindet sich die Zentralbank in einer 'informationsreichen Phase' vor ihrem nächsten Treffen.
de.headline: Fed hält die Zinsen konstant, während sie weitere Informationen abwarten

en.body: According to Reuters, the Fed left its benchmark interest rate unchanged as it awaited 'accumulation of more information'. According to The New York Times, the central bank is in an 'information-rich period' before its next meeting.
en.headline: Fed holds rates steady as it awaits more information

es.body: Según Reuters, la Fed dejó sin cambios su tasa de interés de referencia mientras esperaba la 'acumulación de más información'. Según The New York Times, el banco central se encuentra en un 'período rico en información' antes de su próxima reunión.
es.headline: La Fed mantiene las tasas sin cambios mientras espera más información

fr.body: Selon Reuters, la Fed a laissé son taux d'intérêt de référence inchangé alors qu'elle attendait l'« accumulation de plus d'informations ». Selon The New York Times, la banque centrale est dans une « période riche en informations » avant sa prochaine réunion.
fr.headline: La Fed maintient les taux stables alors qu'elle attend plus d'informations

it.body: Secondo Reuters, la Fed ha lasciato invariato il tasso di interesse di riferimento mentre attendeva 'l'accumulo di ulteriori informazioni'. Secondo The New York Times, la banca centrale si trova in un 'periodo ricco di informazioni' prima della sua prossima riunione.
it.headline: La Fed mantiene i tassi stabili mentre attende ulteriori informazioni

ja.body: ロイターによると、連邦準備制度はベンチマーク金利を据え置き、"情報の蓄積"を待っている。ニューヨーク・タイムズによると、中央銀行は次回会合前の"情報豊富な期間"にある。
ja.headline: 連邦準備制度は情報を待つ間金利を据え置く

ko.body: 로이터에 따르면 연준은 “추가 정보 축적”을 기다리면서 기준 금리를 변동 없이 유지했다. 뉴욕 타임스에 따르면 중앙은행은 다음 회의 전 “정보가 풍부한 시기”에 있다.
ko.headline: 연준, 추가 정보를 기다리며 금리 동결

pt.body: De acordo com a Reuters, o Fed deixou a sua taxa de referência de juros inalterada enquanto aguardava o "acúmulo de mais informação". O The New York Times indica que o banco central está num "período rico em informação" antes da sua próxima reunião.
pt.headline: Fed mantém as taxas estáveis enquanto aguarda mais informação

zh.body: 据路透社报道，美联储将基准利率维持不变，等待‘更多信息的积累’。据《纽约时报》报道，央行正处于‘信息丰富期’，在下一次会议前。
zh.headline: 美联储维持利率不变，等待更多信息
